summary: Clearwater NF site at 5,274 ft: L-4 cab built 1934 (1931 per one source), abandoned in the 1940s, now gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-4 cab, with a 20-foot L-6 tower about two miles northwest as a patrol point
facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1940s; no source describes what remains

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site 'Drive-Up Abandoned'; no source describes current access

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and the 2016 Clearwater National Forest list give 1934; Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1931. The record uses 1934 because two sources agree, and the 1931 date is stated in the event note and story.

sources.title: Clearwater National Forest Lookouts
sources.publisher: USDA Forest Service, Clearwater National Forest

notes_for_editor: The L-4 cab date conflicts (1934 in two sources, 1931 in Idaho Fire Lookouts); the record uses 1934 and states both. The brief's 1940 is corrected to the 1940s. Coordinates: the brief's FFLA point is 46.78189, -115.39837 and its idaho_fl point is 46.78895, -115.42974, about 2.5 km apart; neither Idaho Fire Lookouts page we read prints coordinates, so the record was not changed. Source 2 explains the place name only, not the lookout's history. Elevation 5,274 ft. No staffing or fire history was found (Idaho Fire Lookouts says no staffing history is documented). No photos were captured, and no source describes the site today or public access.
